title: Facilitating Self-Guided Mental Health Interventions Through Human-Language Model Interaction: A Case Study of Cognitive Restructuring

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing self-reported intervention outcomes (such as reduction in emotion intensity and reframe helpfulness) across different age groups (13 to 65+) in a large-scale field study, and conducting an additional randomized trial modifying reading complexity specifically for adolescents.
Comparing self-reported cognitive restructuring intervention outcomes across participants identifying as female, male, and non-binary.
Evaluating and comparing the effectiveness of the AI-guided intervention based on self-reported outcomes across various racial and ethnic demographic groups.
Analyzing the self-reported intervention effectiveness and outcomes across participants with varying levels of educational attainment, ranging from Middle School to Doctorate degrees.
